$comment: Verdicts on upstream PRs, consumed by scripts/check-upstream.mjs.
Any open upstream PR missing from this file is reported as NEEDS TRIAGE and
raises the weekly alert. Add a verdict here to silence it.
The human-readable rationale lives in ROADMAP.md § Upstream harvest — keep both in sync.

skip = decided against | noise = someone's generated clone output
